name: How do I choose the right contractor for a complex full-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a complex full-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for a complex full-home remodel requires evaluating their experience, process, and specialization in substantial renovations. Look for a design-build firm that offers a single point of coordination and has a proven track record, particularly with projects similar to yours. AKN Design Group, with over two decades in business and thousands of jobs completed, emphasizes honesty, reliability, and craftsmanship. Our focus on the homeowner experience and clear communication ensures that you are partnered with a team committed to your project's success from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, process, and specialization in substantial renovations. Look for a design-build firm with a proven track record and a single point of coordination for complex projects.
